scope: Output-port chooser, popup placement, menu typography and adjacent layout regression

build.type: Fresh out-of-tree build followed by incremental rebuilds of final changes

popup_coverage: Uniform item geometry and bold default label in both languages and themes
Long labels with tooltips; 1000 choices with filtering, scrolling and empty-search handling
Mouse and keyboard confirmation; Escape and click-outside cancellation without graph mutation
Real cascading-menu keyboard activation followed by explicit non-default port selection
Undo restores the original workflow; pending chooser cannot survive source-node deletion
Owner movement/resizing closes a visible chooser; hidden owner cannot open a pending chooser
Geometry inside logical owner/screen bounds, including synthetic negative monitor coordinates

fixed: Output chooser anchored to source node instead of last submenu cursor position
Queued cascade focus loss no longer dismisses the next output chooser
Shared menu typography and explicit root-menu placement
Result-directory title wrapping and language-aware step-status column width

limits: No native Windows or macOS execution; native popup focus, screen transitions and input require acceptance checks.
Negative monitor coordinates are pure geometry tests, not a physical multi-monitor session.
QMenu cascading submenus and button menus retain Qt screen-boundary behavior; strict owner containment applies to OutputPicker.
Algorithm suites were not rerun in this UI-only batch; alpha.4 numerical and alpha.5 performance records retain their original scope.
Cross-node joint inputs and transactional node insertion/replacement are not implemented in this batch.
log_policy: Only final successful regression outputs are included; workspace and temporary paths are sanitized.
